storyboard_arc.setup: Isla notices the incoming errands but takes a kept moment with the grid before her day starts.
storyboard_arc.disruption: The train falls behind schedule, tempting her to close her screen and hurry through the morning.
storyboard_arc.choice: Seeking a quick reset, Isla ignores the alerts and claims a kept pocket of library time instead.
storyboard_arc.puzzle_moment: Knowing a rushed Trigoku move leads to errors, she carefully double-checks the constraint first.
storyboard_arc.consequence: Taking her time pays off; the pending task suddenly feels manageable rather than stressful.
storyboard_arc.resolution: Wrapping up, Isla carries this sense of steady calm into the busy afternoon ahead.

captions:
Just one quick look before the rush starts.
Isla notices the incoming errands but takes a kept moment with the grid before her day starts.

Today has its own little rule-set — check the constraint before rushing.
The train falls behind schedule, tempting her to close her screen and hurry through the morning.

Let's take a few minutes just to breathe.
Seeking a quick reset, Isla ignores the alerts and claims a kept pocket of library time instead.

No rushing. Let's verify this constraint first.
Knowing a rushed Trigoku move leads to errors, she carefully double-checks the constraint first.

It actually worked. That feels much better.
Taking her time pays off; the pending task suddenly feels manageable rather than stressful.

I'm keeping this calm pace for the rest of the day.
Wrapping up, Isla carries this sense of steady calm into the busy afternoon ahead.

co-working desk near a tall window
